meta_title: REKKI Alternative for Food Distributors in 2026
meta_desc: Keep REKKI's robots and add an app your accounts speak orders into, confirming every line first. A REKKI alternative that leaves less for anything to read.

hero.h1: Need A REKKI Alternative? Give Accounts A Voice.
hero.lead: Cut the orders anything has to read. VoiceOrder Solutions works alongside REKKI's robots: your account talks its order into our app, picks from its own guide, and confirms the lines before they reach you. OrderAI and InboxAI keep working on whatever still arrives as a message.

stats.label: Comes back on each order once off the phone

problem.h2: Why distributors weigh an alternative to REKKI
problem.lead: Hunting for a REKKI competitor is rarely about doubting the robots. It is usually one specific worry about the orders they read, and that worry has an answer that leaves the robots running.

cards.h3: An error rate is still a rate
cards.body: REKKI publishes theirs. A number exists because a machine is working out what the order said, and they stand behind it with double checks and a refund guarantee. When the buyer builds the order from their guide and checks it before sending, nobody has to reconstruct it from a message afterwards.

Their site says your team trains the robot to fit your business, and that it starts processing orders and learning right away. That is real control. For accounts on our app, your existing order guides are the setup.

cards.h3: The messy order keeps being written
cards.body: Software that copes beautifully with a scrawled message stays busy because the messages keep arriving. For some accounts you would rather the message never got written, and our app can take those while the robot carries on.

cards.h2: Where REKKI's robots and VoiceOrder Solutions each fit
cards.lead: Keeping both is a reasonable call. Our app is not a REKKI replacement: it takes a slice of your book off writing messages at all, and whatever still turns up as an email or a voicemail needs reading by something. A REKKI alternative often turns out to mean exactly that.

items.h3: A shorter pile to be right about
items.body: Kitchens on the app hand over a checked list rather than a message. Anything you have reading the rest gets a smaller stack to work through.

items.h3: Whatever wins you new accounts is untouched
items.body: Anything bringing you new buyers should carry on bringing them. We have no marketplace and no interest in who finds you; we only handle the ordering once they have.

items.h3: Begin with the kitchens that phone most
items.body: Nothing else has to give way for it, so start on the few accounts that eat the most of the morning and judge it on those.

faq.h2: Better than REKKI, or less for it to read?

items.q: Is VoiceOrder Solutions a REKKI alternative, or something to add?
items.a: One to add, not swap. REKKI automates the work your office does on orders that have already arrived, plus the inbox and the upselling. We change the way one group of customers orders, so less of that work exists. REKKI's robots can stay on the rest.

items.q: Is the voice app more accurate than REKKI?
items.a: Not in those terms. Our safeguard is different: every line is picked from the account's guide and the buyer checks each one before sending. Theirs measures how well a machine reads an order a person wrote. That is a different kind of check, not a better percentage.

items.q: So can an order still be wrong?
items.a: Of course. Somebody can confirm the wrong quantity, as they can on any order ever placed. What changes is who reads the lines last: the person who wants the goods, before anything leaves. This only covers orders placed in our app: a call or a voicemail to your desk gets no number, no timestamp and nothing moving against stock.

items.q: Does your app connect to REKKI?
items.a: No. There is no link between the two and no joint support. OrderAI keeps passing what it reads into your system, and our orders come separately, emailed as a file or sent in over EDI or the API.

items.q: Some of our customers already use the REKKI app. What happens?
items.a: Nothing breaks. Their chef app is free and, by their own account, sends orders to suppliers whether or not the supplier signed up, converting them to email for your order address. Those keep arriving as they do now. Give our app to the accounts who prefer speaking to typing, and leave the ones already happy where they are.

They are more open here than we are, and that deserves saying: their site carries an opening figure per customer and what it includes. It is quoted in pounds, and their marketplace is described as UK only, while the app itself is described as working anywhere in the world. Ours is quote-based and nothing is published, so ask and you will get a figure for the voice step on its own.

items.q: How fast could this be running?
items.a: Most distributors are running it in 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens have an order in that day. Nothing in REKKI is touched or rewired, which matters if you came looking for a REKKI alternative with only one problem to settle.

items.q: Where do the REKKI details on this page come from?
items.a: Taken from rekki.com, as of 10 October 2026: the robot descriptions, the accuracy and training wording, the published starting price and the chef app questions. Their performance figures are their own and are not quoted here as results. If any of it has moved on, the mistake is at our end.
